column1: Table 24.3. Asynchronous fruit production by sets of tree species with morphologically similar fruits, Kuala Lompat 1976-77.
N = number of trees observed with fruit. C = canopy levels in which fruit is borne: E, emergent; U, upper; M, middle; L, lower. L = length of fruit (mm).

At Kuala Lompat, eaten by: gibbons (G), macaques (M), hornbills (HB), pigeons (P), barbets (B); other small birds, including bulbuls, flowerpeckers, leafbirds (SB) (all mainly seed dispersers); leaf monkeys (L), Ratufa (R), Callosciurus (C), Sundasciurus (S) (all mainly seed predators). From Raemaekers et al., 1980.
